name: @setnayan/mobile
description: Setnayan native shell (Capacitor remote-URL) for iOS + Android. Loads the hosted Next.js app and bridges native Camera/Network/BLE.

comments.overrides: This project is EXCLUDED from the root pnpm workspace (see pnpm-workspace.yaml) — Capacitor needs a flat node_modules — so it carries its own npm overrides. Everything here is devDependency-only asset tooling (@capacitor/assets generates the app icons + splash screens from assets/, run by hand); nothing below ships in the app.
comments.tar-hoisted: `tar` was scoped under @capacitor/assets > @capacitor/cli. That left a SECOND copy at the tree root still on 7.5.16, which GHSA-w8wr-v893-vjvp covers (<=7.5.17). Hoisted to a plain top-level override so both resolve to the patched line; still a patch bump inside tar 7.x.
comments.sharp-and-uuid-left-alone: sharp@0.32.6 (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj) and uuid@7.0.3 (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq) stay as they are. Both are patched only across MAJOR/minor lines @capacitor/assets@3.0.5 was never built against (sharp 0.32 -> 0.35 crosses three release lines that removed APIs and repackaged the prebuilt binaries; uuid 7 -> 11 is four majors), and neither is reachable: this tooling runs on the maintainer's own machine over the repo's own icon files, never in CI, never at app runtime. Revisit when @capacitor/assets itself updates.
comments.seen-and-not-taken: Do not add an @opentelemetry/core or a web-app sharp entry here — those live in the ROOT package.json's pnpm.overrides and are documented there.
